answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, held in escrow until finality, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The sparrow is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the juniper. By the raven of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
